release_name: Live TV v5.1.17 (Build 52) — Pro Broadcast Suite: Recall, Lip-Sync, Spotlight Search & Match Alerts
min_os_mac: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later (Apple Silicon)
changelog: ⇄ Last Channel Recall (Q): Instant flashback toggle between your current and previous channel with one click or keypress
🎚️ Audio Lip-Sync Offset Calibrator: Real-time Web Audio delay compensation (-500ms to +1500ms) with presets in playback settings
🔍 In-Player Spotlight Channel Search (/): Instant modal HUD search across all 2,989+ channels with keyboard navigation without leaving fullscreen playback
🔔 Sports Match Start Reminder: Set match alerts on upcoming cricket, football, tennis and MotoGP fixtures with audio chime and 1-tap tune
🔎 Custom Video Zoom & Pan (Z): 1.0x to 2.0x video zoom with touch pinch-to-zoom and drag-to-pan to crop letterboxing and inspect action
↻ Stream Auto-Retry & Reconnect Watchdog: Automatic 3-stage reconnect recovery on CDN stalls with immediate manual reconnect button
